description: Fork of exp344. SoftMultiHeadLUT(hard=False) replacing all 4 LUT modules. Temperature annealed log-linearly from soft_temp_start=0.5 to soft_temp_end=0.001 over 8000 steps (T = 0.5 * (0.001/0.5)^(step/N) per step). exp343 attempt at T_start=5.0 was too soft to learn; this starts at exp336's operating T=0.5 and anneals to a much sharper end (T=0.001, essentially argmax). Shape unchanged from exp336.
